specimens.name: Compact foot-mounted industrial electric motor
specimens.notes: ribbed foot-mounted industrial motor with shaft, feet and terminal box is clearly readable

specimens.name: Standardized motor-and-helical-gearbox package
specimens.notes: motor and inline cast gearbox form one standardized package with a single output shaft

specimens.name: Hydraulic cylinder
specimens.notes: painted cylinder, polished rod, clevis ends and two hose ports are clearly present without hoses

specimens.name: Compact hydraulic rotary actuator
specimens.notes: compact cast rotary actuator body with flange, shaft and two ports is readable without external mechanism

specimens.name: Guarded V-belt drive fragment
specimens.notes: formed sheet surrounds the top and sides, but the full front face leaves the V-belt and both pulleys exposed; it reads as an open transmission rather than a protective safety guard

specimens.name: Guarded roller-chain drive fragment
specimens.notes: formed housing surrounds the perimeter but the full front face leaves chain and sprockets exposed; this violates the guarded-drive requirement

specimens.name: Industrial linear solenoid actuator
specimens.notes: coil housing, straight plunger and mounting flange are clear with no wiring

specimens.name: Electromagnetic clutch/brake module
specimens.notes: the cylindrical vented housing with feet reads primarily as another electric motor/generator rather than an unambiguous clutch/brake module

review_method: direct visual inspection of the exact untouched PNG against game-production@6e8875ef6fc2180dad4483e41839642b7cb7da6b guarded 8-specimen spec, canonical style, and exact E0 manual-drives comparison SHA-256 36c52034690af8c1d78221bfe3d849cec175363ac41318b13c144b8c41ad9a46; canonical request SHA-256 9f7578fb04d733e1ccaaede260e4ffafd29ccd24430d7328af228b0a6480ff82
rejection_reasons: specimens 05 and 06 expose the moving belt/chain transmissions through the entire front face instead of showing a protective safety guard
the exposed-transmission presentation regresses toward the E0 open-drive language explicitly forbidden by the E1 spec
specimen 08 remains motor-like and does not read unambiguously as an electromagnetic clutch/brake module
